title: incident-bot: add on-call quicklinks + slo-toolkit runbook helpers
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: On-call responders frequently need quick access to runbooks and SLO context during incidents. This PR adds a compact "quicklinks" UI and a set of slo-toolkit helper utilities that surface runbook links, SLO summaries, and recommended first actions directly in incident-bot messages.

What changed: added a new quicklinks feature that auto-suggests runbook links based on SLO tags and incident metadata; introduced slo_toolkit.helpers.runbook_utils with heuristics for link scoring and TTL-based caching; wired the helpers into the incident-bot oncall summary flow; added e2e tests and unit coverage; updated README and runbook docs.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1987) - [x] Unit tests for helpers - [x] E2E test for quicklinks rendering - [x] Metrics/emitted spans for scoring decisions - [x] Docs + migration notes

Related: ENG-1987 (design), ENG-2021 (oncall ergonomics), SUP-4321 (customer reported need for faster runbook access).
